_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 49 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 123,270 berths as of December 31, 2016'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2016 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 49 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 123,270 berths as of December 31, 2016'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2016 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.13x; +24% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.94; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.7%/yr (Q1 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.9%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2017-03-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.13x (94.8% downside to Bear $5 / +44.5% upside to Bull $138) | Adj composite 3.13 vs market 2.19: gap +0.94 [UNDERVALUED] | +24% above the EPP floor $77 (11x FY17E $7.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +14.5% total (+7.3%/yr) | At 13.6x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $126 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Net Yields +3.4% in Q4 2016, forward net revenue +5.55-6.05% (Q1 2017 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
